messages:
ash: Quick proposal  - let's run a 6-week pilot for a lightweight postmortem follow-up flow. core pieces: small tracker, weekly 15m sync, rotating closure owner, and automated recurrence surfacing. keep it low friction.

lina: love it. what does the tracker need? i vote for explicit 'next action' + owner + due date + verification.

ash: exactly. minimal columns. trying to avoid long-form spreadsheets. example template inlined: 

ash: ```
Tiny follow-up tracker cols:
- incident_id
- one-line summary
- next_action (short)
- owner
- due_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- status (open/in-progress/blocked/done)
- verification (how we'll confirm fix)
- recurrence_count
- last_seen
- notes/link_to_rca
```

devin: add "closure_owner" field separate from remediation owner. closure_owner owns shepherding to done and verification. rotates weekly with oncall.

ops-bot: Heads-up: INC-2178 has 3 overdue actions. Please review.

lina: i'll volunteer to be first closure_owner to kick things off and migrate backlog items into the tracker by 2145679000 (end of week).

ash: thanks. i'll set up a calendar weekly slot: Fridays 09:30 PT, 15m. attendees: oncall, last-RCA-owner, infra rep, docs owner. agenda: quick status (each item <=30s), unblock asks, one recurrence highlight.

sarah: for recurrence detection, i'll write a small job to fingerprint incidents by stack signature + error_text and emit a weekly top-10 CSV. will add recurrence_count and last_seen into tracker. prototype by 2145679400.

devin: we should define a simple SLA for remediation: P0 items target 7d, P1 21d, P2 60d unless blocked. enforce by weekly review.

lina: can we add a "regression_check" milestone: metric to watch + check at 7 days and 30 days post-fix? reduces ship-and-forget.

ash: good call. include in verification field. also add an auto-reminder from ops-bot when due_date within 48h.

ops-bot: Reminder created: follow-up sync recurring Friday 09:30 PT.

ash: immediate action list:
- migrate backlog PMs & RCAs into tracker (lina) - due 2145679000
- create handbook page + tracker template (ash) - due 2145679050
- recurrence prototype job (sarah) - due 2145679400
- set weekly invite and rotation rules (ash) - done
- enforce SLA tiers document (devin) - due 2145679200

lina: i'll start migration now and ping owners for any missing info. keeping fields minimal should help adoption. :+1:

sarah: will wire the csv into the hub and flag top recurrent items in the weekly.

ash: thanks team. we'll run the pilot 6 weeks and measure closure rate + time-to-close + recurrence density. if effective, we'll fold into oncall SOP. will post the hub link once the handbook page is up. :rocket:
